subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding fees (expense ratios) associated with funds and why lower fees matter over the long term
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares the long-term growth of two identical simulated investments with different fee percentages
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a higher fee to its larger long-term drag on investment growth
exercise.abstract: Student explains why a seemingly small difference in fees can significantly affect long-term investment growth

misconception_flags: believes a small percentage fee difference has a negligible effect over a long time horizon

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
